body_markdown:
LOUISVILLE, KY (Oct 27, 2026) — The new 2027 Warrior 1500XD and Sentinel 1500 HVAC Crew made their debut at Equip Exposition, October 20 to 23 in Louisville, Kentucky. Massimo's booth was busy all week, and the show produced more than 100 prospective dealer leads.


Both vehicles run on Massimo's new 1,499cc inline four-cylinder engine.


**Warrior 1500XD**


- Rugged all-metal body construction
- 29-inch all-terrain tires
- 10-inch touchscreen display
- Full-size crew configuration
- Integrated onboard cooler


**Sentinel 1500 HVAC Crew**


- Factory cab with integrated heating and air conditioning
- Heated and cooled seating
- Integrated onboard cooler
- Four-door crew layout for year-round work and play


Massimo also showed the MVR Cargo Max HVAC, an all-electric utility vehicle for warehouses, campuses, property management and municipalities.


"We believe there is a meaningful opportunity between traditional value UTVs and the extremely high-priced machines at the top end of the market," said Quenton Petersen, CEO of Massimo Group.
